notes: The release that publishes each platform's CPU Skia archive (tools/skia_archive.py), read by its tag.
identity is skia_archive.identity of the tree that built it; archive_sha256 is the archive's digest in that release's manifest.

Until a platform is pinned, every push to main publishes its current archive in that revision's build release. Pin the newest one, then keep its revision in packaging/pinned_cache_revisions.json so that the release is never pruned.
Change a pin with every identity change, once the new archive is published.
